title: add-residency-policy-simulator-kms-fallback-and-operator-scope-rbac
author: Nadia Kapoor
description:
Motivation: customers and SREs need a safe way to evaluate data-residency and KMS routing policies before enforcing them globally. This PR introduces a residency policy simulator (dry-run mode), an operator-scoped temporal RBAC binding for safe operator actions, and a configurable KMS-fallback chain with audit enrichment so that decision provenance is recorded for compliance reviews.

What this changes: adds a CLI + HTTP simulator that runs routing and RBAC decisions against live policy tables without affecting traffic; implements operator-scoped RBAC roles that can be time-limited and observable; adds a KMS-fallback resolver that will attempt primary provider -> regional replica -> vault-ephemeral sequence and emits structured audit events for each hop; enriches audit logs with residency_decision and kms_path fields. Also includes docs, integration tests, and e2e test fixtures.

Implementation notes: the simulator lives in cmd/policy-sim (Go) and reuses the policy-compiler in pkg/policy/engine. The operator RBAC changes are in pkg/rbac/v2 and introduce a new "operator_window" claim processed by the enforcement middleware. KMS changes are implemented in pkg/kms/resolver with a pluggable resolver interface; the default chain is configurable via infra/helm values. Audit enrichment is done in pkg/audit/enricher which populates event.metadata.residency_decision and event.metadata.kms_path (JSON array of tried providers).

Commits summary: 1) bootstrap simulator binary and HTTP shim; 2) policy-compiler: add simulation hooks and result schema; 3) rbac v2: add operator_window claim and temporal binding evaluation; 4) kms: implement chain resolver and metrics; 5) audit: add enrichment and wire into request path; 6) docs: simulator guide and migration notes; 7) tests: unit + integration + a deterministic policy-sim test harness.

Files changed (high level): cmd/policy-sim/main.go, pkg/policy/engine/compiler.go, pkg/rbac/v2/enforcer.go, pkg/kms/resolver.go, pkg/audit/enricher.go, internal/config/values.yaml, docs/security/residency-simulator.md, helm/values-security.yaml, test/integration/policy_sim_test.go, examples/residency/sample-policy.yaml.

Testing and CI: unit coverage added for policy simulation and kms resolver (~86% for changed packages). Integration test runs against a local in-memory KMS adapter and a mock policy store. CI had an initial lint failure (goimports) which was fixed in the follow-up commit. The final CI run is green (build, unit, integration, lint).

Backwards compatibility and rollout: simulator and audit enrichment are non-breaking and default to off for Hosted customers. The operator-scoped RBAC introduces new role templates; existing roles continue to work. KMS fallback chain defaults to a single provider but can be configured via helm values; rollout plan recommends enabling simulator + dry-run for 2 weeks and reviewing enriched audit logs before flipping enforcement.

Upgrade notes / migration: operators should add the new temporal binding to operator service-accounts if they need emergency overrides. Helm chart adds values.security.kmsFallbackChain and values.security.enableResidencySim. Docs include example Linear tickets for staged rollout.

Checklist: - [x] add simulator CLI and HTTP shim - [x] wire simulation into policy compiler - [x] implement operator_window claim and enforcement - [x] add KMS chain resolver + metrics - [x] emit residency_decision and kms_path to audit stream - [x] tests (unit/integration/e2e) - [x] docs and helm values - [x] run CI and fix lint issues

Related work: references ENG-7324 (policy compiler refactor), ENG-7401 (audit schema consolidation), and ENG-7521 (residency controls).

Release notes: "Security: Add a residency policy simulator (dry-run), operator-scoped temporal RBAC bindings, pluggable KMS-fallback resolver, and audit enrichment for residency and KMS decision paths. Simulator is configurable and off by default for Hosted deployments."
